programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S7/E6 - Triple D Nation: Pick Flavor'. Guy Fieri's picking up gourmet tacos in Phoenix, a signature mac cheesy pizza in Boston, and out-of-bounds oxtails in Texas.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S6/E13 - Some Like It Hot And Brothy'. Four chefs track down ingredients for tart and tangy dishes. In the second stakeout, things get heated when the competitors make hot and brothy bowls.

programme.title: Maneet's Eats
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Chicken Tikka Masala And Aloo Gobi'. Maneet Chauhan is cooking up her signature shortcut recipe for a classic chicken tikka masala, followed by a vegetarian feast of aloo gobi.

programme.title: Maneet's Eats
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Samosas And Pork Vindaloo'. Maneet Chauhan prepares a crowd-pleasing appetizer of crispy fried Samosas with a creamy potato pea filling and a spicy main course of pork vindaloo.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S6/E1 - Eric Ripert'. Chef Eric Ripert stops by Ina Garten's barn to share some French apple tart, stunning seared tuna with ginger soy salad, and life-changing stories.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S6/E2 - Julia Louis-Dreyfus'. Actor Julia Louis-Dreyfus joins Ina to swap her life lessons and stories for a classic French omelette and a chocolate cake frosting masterclass.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S39/E11 - Super Spicy Games'. Four spice-obsessed chefs bring the heat to make a hometown spicy dish that has the overheated judges begging for mercy.

programme.title: Hot Dish With Franco
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Easy Entertaining'. Franco Noriega makes fresh bruschetta, easy risotto, tangy chicken and a fruity salad for a quick weeknight meal that's perfect for entertaining.

programme.title: Hot Dish With Franco
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - A Mexican Feast'. Franco Noriega makes a Mexican feast highlighting his Vegetable Ceviche. Then, he whips up grilled shrimp and pineapple tacos with pineapple guacamole.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S5/E1 - Nicole Mann'. Astronaut Nicole Mann joins Ina to share stories from her time in orbit. Ina bakes an apple crostata and gives a masterclass in seared scallops.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S5/E2 - David Remnick'. Ina Garten makes overnight Belgium waffles for Pulitzer Prize-winning author David Remnick before hosting a parmesan chicken cooking class.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S46/E2 - Beasts And Bourbon'. Four chefs are challenged to make a meal using high rye bourbon and bison ribeye. Later, they must create a dessert featuring chunky blue cheese dressing.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E8 - From North To South America'. From a Houston joint's Argentinian empanadas to street tacos in Cancun, Mexico, Guy Fieri digs into flavours spanning the Americas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E9 - Goin' International'. Guy Fieri grabs gangster global grub such as oxtail and curry goat from a Jamaican joint in Houston, and a 24-hour burrito hot spot in Cancun, Mexico.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E10 - Wonder Women'. Guy Fieri visits all-female line-ups in Houston and Orlando. A grandma serves up family recipes like homemade tamales, and he checks out a funky meatball spot.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E11 - Multicultural Cooking'. Guy Fieri digs into the gastronomic traditions of different cultures including a Mexican joint in Houston and a Jewish deli-on-wheels in Orlando, Florida.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E12 - Turkey, Taters And Dogs'. Guy digs into a mashup of flavours, including a potato-centric palace dishing out hearty Brazilian specialties and a deli serving latkes and turkey pastrami.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E13 - Burgers, Beef And Barbecue'. Guy Fieri samples beef and barbecue in Florida and California, including a Vietnamese spot serving up tasty pho and a BBQ joint making a twist on lasagne.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E14 - Chicken Trifecta'. Guy Fieri hits the road for top chicken dinners. In Hawaii visits Mick Fleetwood's restaurant and he checks out a California hot dog spot's chicken and waffles.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E15 - From Spicy To Icy'. Guy Fieri heats up with spice and cools off with ice! He visits a hot BBQ joint in California, a Cajun spot in Virginia and a Hawaiian place's tropical shaved ice.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E16 - Island And Desert'. Guy Fieri hunts desert and island flavour. He enjoys nostalgic breakfast tarts at a café in California and fish and chips at a gluten-free spot in Hawaii.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S27/E1 - Sandwiches, Spaetzle And Wings'. In Virginia, Guy Fieri finds a spot serving sandwiches by day and sticky wings at night. In Hawaii, a German-Swiss joint dishes up apple strudel.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S27/E2 - Flavor Adventure'. Guy Fieri takes a culinary trip with adventurous flavour. A funky LA spot fills bowls with eclectic eats while a Norfolk, VA, market offers Mexican specialties.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S35/E9 - Destination Dishes'. The hosts share recipes inspired by memorable vacations, from German party cheese dip to classic Italian meatballs.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S36/E1 - Better Duck Next Time'. In round one the competitors face a surprising and challenging ingredient - duck tongue. A peachy basket provides a challenge for the final, dessert, round.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Grandma Vernelle's Ambrosia'. Chef Casey Corn travels to Los Angeles to help a close-knit group of cousins recreate their grandma's lost ambrosia recipe.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Grandma Lil's Meatball Sauce'. Casey visits a New York family to help them rediscover their Grandma Lil's unique, Jewish-Italian-American meatball sauce.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Myra's Matzo Ball Soup'. Casey digs into a beloved Jewish classic, matzo ball soup, to help a married couple in Norwalk, Connecticut, track down a fourth-generation recipe.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Grandma Bea's Stew Chicken'. Casey and Thomas Mulzac, a chef based in Brooklyn, explore his family's roots while working to replicate his grandma's famous stew chicken recipe.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Great-Grandma's Lasagna'. Host Casey Corn helps a family recreate their great-grandmother Antonia's homemade lasagne with paper-thin layers and a 'sneaky' white sauce.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Grandma Leonor's Capirotada'. Host Casey Corn helps a woman recreate her grandmother's perfectly balanced capirotada, a traditional Mexican dish similar to bread pudding.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S34/E4 - Wilderness Chefs'. Three wilderness chefs hunt through Flavortown Market to make fireside favourites and an elevated backcountry dinner for a chance to win $20,000.

programme.title: Triple D Nation: Pancakes, Potatoes...
programme.desc: 'Triple D Nation: Pancakes, Potatoes And Pizza'. Guy Fieri is in Vancouver, BC, to check out an elevated eatery serving the ultimate in diner food. And, he visits a Korean-inspired, French oven-baked pizza parlour in Minneapolis.

programme.title: Triple D Nation: Poke, Pork...
programme.desc: 'Triple D Nation: Poke, Pork And Chicken Parm'. Guy Fieri's checking in on some of his favourite joints serving up a bite for any time of day. Up in Denver, he tries a couple of new late-night Italian options.
